sisi.depan: A single, colossal pillar of dark stone supports the largest spherical hut of glowing amber, with a distant, slow-moving river of lava visible on the plains beyond.
sisi.kanan: A dense grouping of stone pillars at staggered heights, each topped with a small, round glowing hut, recedes into the shimmering heat haze of the horizon.
sisi.belakang: The ground at the viewer's position is a wide, cracked plateau of warm stone, with bright orange light pulsing up from deep fissures.
sisi.kiri: A natural arch of smooth, black obsidian rock frames a single, impossibly tall and slender pillar holding a tiny, bright hut at its peak.

tengah: A short, thick pillar supporting a modest glowing hut stands in the near-midground to the left, while a series of low, sharp volcanic rock formations jut out from the ground to the right.
atas: The sky is a slow-swirling miasma of incandescent red and molten gold clouds, with no visible sun or moon.
